legacy_behavior: Reads the in-memory OptionMap under its read lock and does not create a Valkey key.
rust_behavior: Reads PostgreSQL first and only consults the existing read-only key lmm:public-content:v1:notice when the authoritative read fails; it never writes a cache key.
rationale: The Rust service no longer lets a stale Valkey entry override a current option. The isolated real-TCP oracle still covers the success envelope and unchanged Valkey snapshots; independent approval remains incomplete because Rust's durable source differs from Go's process-local OptionMap on a live option update.
